items.source: An interface used by CqlTemplate for mapping Nodes of metadata on a per-item basis.. Implementations of this interface perform the actual work of mapping each host to a result object, but don't need to worry about exception handling. DriverException will be caught and handled by the calling CqlTemplate.
items.translation: 这是一个由CqlTemplate使用的接口，用于按项目级别映射元数据的Node。该接口的实现负责执行将每个主机映射到结果对象的实际工作，但无需担心异常处理。DriverException 将由调用的CqlTemplate捕获并处理。

items.source:
Parameters:
hosts - the Iterable of Nodes to map, must not be null.
Returns:
the result objects for the given hosts.
Throws:
com.datastax.oss.driver.api.core.DriverException - if a DriverException is encountered mapping values (that is, there's no need to catch DriverException).
items.translation:
参数：
hosts - 要映射的 Iterable 类型的 Node 集合，不能为 null。
返回：
给定主机的结果对象。
抛出：
com.datastax.oss.driver.api.core.DriverException - 如果在映射值时遇到 DriverException（即无需捕获 DriverException）。
